question: In October 2021, MUDRA Toolbox was launched by the ________ in five Indian languages.

options.text: Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR)

solution:
The correct answer __**Indian Council of Medical Research**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) on 6 October 2021 released the Multilingual Dementia Research and Assessment (MUDRA) toolbox in five Indian languages.
 
• The languages are Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam.
 
• It is a comprehensive tool to diagnose dementia in the Indian population.
 
• It is an initiative undertaken by the ICMR Neuro-Cognitive Tool Box (ICMR-NCTB). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• MUDRA toolbox is a unique tool consisting of various tests and questionnaires and is sensitive to the factors that affect performance on cognitive tests including education, language, and culture.
 
• It is a collective effort by seven leading centers in India including Apollo Hospital (Kolkata), Manipal Hospital, and Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College.
 
• According to the Dementia India Report 2010 by Alzheimer's and Related Disorders Society of India (ARDSI), there are approximately 5.29 million people living with dementia in India.
